justification: Inspected `.mvn/wrapper/MavenWrapperDownloader.java` (no package declaration; only JDK imports: `java.net`, `java.io`, `java.nio.channels`, `java.util`) and unnamed-package fixtures such as `javaparser-core-generators/src/test/resources/com/github/javaparser/generator/core/quality/NotNullGeneratorTest/original/MethodParameterTest.java` (imports `com.github.javaparser.quality.*`) and `javaparser-symbol-solver-testing/src/test/resources/issue3277/StackOverflowTestCase.java` / `javaparser-core-testing-bdd/src/test/resources/com/github/javaparser/samples/ClassInLatin1.java` (unnamed-package samples). Because the unnamed package cannot be imported by named packages, it has no incoming dependencies from the rest of the repo, so it is not a stable package depending on less-stable packages; UD is not present.
